notes_en: Fix: Quran reader no longer shows a blank screen when opening a surah. Root cause was the backend returning words with a null pos_group, which crashed AyahModel parsing. pos_group is now optional and the reader paginates the /ayahs endpoint (backend caps at 20/request) so full surahs load. Surah list is now always all 114, merging live API data into the bundled 114-surah list so it is never partial.
notes_ur: درست: سورہ کھولنے پر اب خالی اسکرین نہیں آتی۔ تمام 114 سورہ اب دکھتے ہیں۔
notes_hi: Fix: Quran reader ab blank screen nahi dikhata. Ab 114 surahs dikhte hain.
